    requires nums != null

        if (SumOfDigits(a) < SumOfDigits(b)) then -1
        else if (SumOfDigits(a) > SumOfDigits(b)) then 1
        else IndexOf(nums, a) < IndexOf(nums, b)) (nums)
    ensures |sorted| == |nums|
    ensures forall i, j: int :: 0 <= i < |sorted| && 0 <= j < |sorted| && sorted[i] == sorted[j] ==> i == j
    
method SumOfDigits(n: int) returns (sum: int)
    requires n == 0 || n > 0 || n < 0
    ensures sum >= 0
    ensures sum == SumOfDigitsHelper(abs(n))
    
function SumOfDigitsHelper(n: int) : int
    requires n >= 0
    ensures result >= 0
    ensures result == (if n == 0 then 0 else (n % 10) + SumOfDigitsHelper(n / 10))

function IndexOf(seq: seq<int>, value: int) : int
    requires seq != null
    ensures result >= 0 || result == |seq|
    ensures result < |seq| ==> seq[result] == value
```
